description: An SDK project imports a YAML Fragment and patches the image of workload/api; expected/model.json is the state after the patch. The Go half loads the Fragment through a one-line root.

parity.sdk: Imports fragment.yaml, then sets the image of workload/api to ghcr.io/example/api:1.5.0 with a typed patch; provenance keeps the YAML declaration and records the patch with fields ["/spec/image"].
